title: 第3766章 临渊城府观棋遁逃第3765章 剑斩冥卫金蝉脱壳
content_zh:
第3766章临渊城府，观棋遁逃
虚无之中走出云梭的傅临渊此时不再遮掩自己的真实实力！
身形一闪便跟‘叶峰’等人缠斗了起来。
从一开始傅临渊就占据了上风，几乎是一个人压着所有人打。
可仅仅只是数息的交手，傅临渊就敏锐地察觉到了不对劲儿……
在他先前的感知中，眼前的几人可没有这么不堪一击。
一记凶狠的剑芒将众人击退，傅临渊眉头一皱，眼露思索之色。
“不对劲儿啊……”
虽然眼前的几人神魂力量丝毫没有变弱，甚至攻击强度也都能达到主境级别。
可他还是觉得不对劲儿。
傅临渊知道他们没有变弱，却也没有他预想中的那么强！
如果只有如今展现出来的实力，别说斩杀两大冥卫了。
恐怕他们几个早就被冥卫擒杀！
可此时天地之间逸散的气息都彰显着这些人没有那么简单。
特别是那个透露着主境气息的女子。
其神魂之强，冰霜之力甚至能够伤到他的神魂。
可……仅仅只是如此，还不足以斩杀两大冥卫。
傅临渊眼眸闪烁的盯着不远处的李观棋等人。
他能明显感知到几个人都是以李观棋马首是瞻，他才是几个人的绝对中心。
“你们……到底在搞什么鬼？”

言罢，傅临渊直接从储物戒中取出那本黑色的‘生死簿’。
体内冥元涌荡之下，生死簿爆发出一股强大无比的玄奥之力。
黑光从天而降笼罩在几人身上！
但是这股力量并没有什么直接的杀伤力。
生死簿上的名字和气息都彰显着就是眼前几人，这让傅临渊更加感到有些费解。
胸膛起伏间口吐浊气，傅临渊眼底闪过一抹狠色，抬手探入虚无之中。
哗啦啦！！！
漆黑的铁索缓缓从虚无中被扯了出来。
这锁链正是勾魂使的独有冥器，勾魂索！
一旦被勾魂索盯上，寻常游魂即便是逃出千万里也无法挣脱！
‘叶峰’等人见状互相对视一眼，毫不犹豫地转身就跑。
众人分散成几个方向四散而逃。
content_en:
Chapter 3766 Linyuan City Mansion, watching chess and escaping
Fu Linyuan, who walked out of Yunsuo out of nothingness, no longer concealed his true strength!
As soon as his figure flashed, he started fighting with 'Ye Feng' and others.
Fu Linyuan had the upper hand from the beginning, almost beating everyone by himself.
But after just a few breaths of fighting, Fu Linyuan was keenly aware that something was wrong...
In his previous perception, the people in front of him were not so vulnerable.
A fierce sword light drove everyone back. Fu Linyuan frowned and his eyes showed contemplation.
"Something's wrong..."
Although the soul power of the few people in front of them has not weakened at all, and even the attack strength has reached the main realm level.
But he still felt something was wrong.
Fu Linyuan knew that they had not become weaker, but they were not as strong as he expected!
If he only had the strength he showed now, let alone killing the two Hades Guards.
I'm afraid some of them have been captured and killed by Hades Guards!
But at this time, the aura escaping between heaven and earth showed that these people were not that simple.
Especially the woman who revealed the aura of the main realm.
His soul is so strong that the power of frost can even damage his soul.
But... just that is not enough to kill the two Hades guards.
Fu Linyuan's eyes flickered as he stared at Li Guanqi and others not far away.
He could clearly sense that several people were following Li Guanqi's lead, and he was the absolute center of them all.
"What the hell are you doing?"
After saying that, Fu Linyuan took out the black 'Book of Life and Death' directly from the storage ring.
Under the surge of Ming Yuan in the body, the Book of Life and Death erupted with an extremely powerful mysterious force.
Black light fell from the sky and enveloped several people!
But this force has no direct lethality.
The names and auras on the book of life and death showed that they were the people in front of him, which made Fu Linyuan even more confused.
Breathing heavily as his chest rose and fell, Fu Linyuan's eyes flashed with a ruthless look, and he raised his hand to reach into the void.
Wow! ! !
The dark iron rope was slowly pulled out of nothingness.
This chain is the Soul Seducer's unique underworld weapon, the Soul Seducer Rope!
Once targeted by the soul seduction rope, ordinary wandering souls cannot escape even if they escape thousands of miles away!
Seeing this, 'Ye Feng' and others looked at each other and turned around and ran away without hesitation.
The crowd scattered into several directions and fled.
